description.en: The validity period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3600.

description.zh: 角色，为 admin 时，表示该用户可以调用“管控类”接口。默认空。
description.en: The role. A value of admin indicates that the user can perform management operations. This parameter is empty by default.

description.zh: 要登录的用户的 ID。 仅限 A-Z,a-z,0-9 及"_"，最长 64 字节。
description.en: The ID of the user to sign in. It can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
